'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell LS Anger, Fear, Aggression''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Roar Used'''. L1 Kashyyyk (V); start is Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) at L2. L5 Gerrgbrrgh → Grakchawwaa (uncertain). L6 Ryyar Ryyerd → Horox Ryyder (V) (uncertain). L9 Wookiee Hwen → Kashyyyk: Wookiee Haven (Forest). L23 marked Non-v.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Advocate
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
